name: tabby-agentdeck
description: Run AI coding agents side by side in Tabby - a live deck of agent sessions with status, a preview panel for the files they touch, agent-friendly hotkeys and image paste

scripts.test: npm run test:existing && npm run test:codex && npm run test:accounts && node test/sidebarI18n.cjs && node test/accountSession.cjs && npm run test:sessions
scripts.test:sessions: tsc src/sessionSearch.ts src/sessionMailbox.ts src/sessionSlots.ts --outDir .tmp --module commonjs --target es2019 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node test/sessionSearch.cjs && node test/sessionCommunication.cjs && node test/mailboxBridge.cjs
scripts.test:accounts: tsc src/accounts.ts src/accountBrowser.ts --outDir .tmp --module commonjs --target es2019 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node test/accounts.test.js
scripts.test:existing: tsc src/codexHooks.ts src/i18n.ts src/prompt.ts src/detect.ts src/claudeHooks.ts src/screen.ts src/bind.ts src/order.ts src/reason.ts src/tabenv.ts src/viewer.ts src/markdown.ts src/ime.ts src/gitDiff.ts src/agents.ts src/group.ts src/project-root.ts src/gitCommit.ts src/diag.ts src/subagents.ts src/nav.ts src/keybind.ts src/sessionLedger.ts src/update.ts src/api.ts src/dock.ts src/status.service.ts src/profile.service.ts src/recovery.service.ts src/meta.ts src/statusLine.ts src/codexMeta.ts --outDir .tmp --module commonjs --target es2019 --skipLibCheck --experimentalDecorators --esModuleInterop && node test/version.test.js && node test/tags.test.js && node test/prompt.test.js && node test/detect.test.js && node test/claudeHooks.test.js && node test/screen.test.js && node test/bind.test.js && node test/order.test.js && node test/reason.test.js && node test/tabenv.test.js && node test/viewer.test.js && node test/markdown.test.js && node test/ime.test.js && node test/gitDiff.test.js && node test/agents.test.js && node test/group.test.js && node test/gitCommit.test.js && node test/diag.test.js && node test/subagents.test.js && node test/nav.test.js && node test/sessionLedger.test.js && node test/update.test.js && node test/api.test.js && node test/dock.test.js && node test/status.service.test.js && node test/profile.service.test.js && node test/recovery.service.test.js && node test/meta.test.js && node test/i18n.test.js && node test/statusLine.test.js && node test/hotkeys.test.js && node test/keybind.test.js && node test/codexMeta.test.js && node test/codexHooks.test.js
